title: AMD Reports Record Q3 2026 Revenue Driven by Data Centers
excerpt: AMD achieved its largest and most profitable quarter in history with $13.4 billion in revenue, fueled heavily by its data center business.
body_html:
AMD has announced its largest and most profitable quarter to date. During the company's quarterly earnings call, CEO Lisa Su stated that the third quarter of 2026 reached unprecedented milestones for the firm.

The company generated a record-breaking $13.4 billion in quarterly revenue. This financial success was significantly driven by the strong performance of AMD's data center business.

Looking ahead, AMD expects this upward financial momentum to continue. The company issued a prediction for the upcoming quarter, forecasting an even higher revenue record of $17 billion.
